points.en: IFAD is a specialized agency of the United Nations and an international financial institution.
points.hi: IFAD is a specialized agency of the United Nations and an international financial institution.

points.en: Established in 1977 as a major outcome of the 1974 World Food Conference.
points.hi: Established in 1977 as a major outcome of the 1974 World Food Conference.

points.en: Focuses on eradicating poverty and hunger in rural areas of developing countries.
points.hi: Focuses on eradicating poverty and hunger in rural areas of developing countries.

points.en: Provides low-interest loans and grants to finance agricultural development projects.
points.hi: Provides low-interest loans and grants to finance agricultural development projects.

points.en: Empowers rural poor to increase food production and nutrition.
points.hi: Empowers rural poor to increase food production and nutrition.

points.en: Promotes climate-resilient agriculture and sustainable natural resource management.
points.hi: Promotes climate-resilient agriculture and sustainable natural resource management.

explanation.en: Focuses on rural poverty reduction through agricultural investment.
explanation.hi: Focuses on rural poverty reduction through agricultural investment.

question.en: Where is the headquarters of IFAD located?
question.hi: Where is the headquarters of IFAD located?

question.en: What is the primary mandate of IFAD?
question.hi: What is the primary mandate of IFAD?

answer.en: To enable poor rural people to improve their food security and nutrition.
answer.hi: To enable poor rural people to improve their food security and nutrition.

misconception.en: IFAD is a part of the World Bank Group.
misconception.hi: IFAD is a part of the World Bank Group.

correction.en: IFAD is a specialized agency of the United Nations, not a part of the World Bank Group.
correction.hi: IFAD is a specialized agency of the United Nations, not a part of the World Bank Group.

threeTraps.en: Confusing IFAD with FAO (Food and Agriculture Organization).
threeTraps.hi: Confusing IFAD with FAO (Food and Agriculture Organization).

threeTraps.en: Assuming it provides only grants (it also provides low-interest loans).
threeTraps.hi: Assuming it provides only grants (it also provides low-interest loans).

threeTraps.en: Thinking it is a regional bank.
threeTraps.hi: Thinking it is a regional bank.

meaning.en: IFAD targets the rural poor to boost agricultural productivity.
meaning.hi: IFAD targets the rural poor to boost agricultural productivity.
